symptoms: Angular chlorotic yellow spots on upper leaf surface delimited by leaf veins; purplish downy mold underneath
Adults feed voraciously on cotyledons and leaves making circular holes; grubs feed underground on roots causing seedling collapse.
management: Dust wood ash on seedling leaves early morning; spray Chlorpyrifos 20% EC @ 2ml/L or Carbaryl 50% WP @ 2g/L.

symptoms: Oviposition punctures ooze fluid; maggots feed inside causing watery pulp decay and premature fruit drop.
management: Install cue-lure traps @ 10/acre; spray bait solution of Jaggery 10g + Malathion 50% EC 2ml/L.

healthy_signs: Turgid, deep green leaves with crisp texture and no chlorosis
Vigorous flowering and uniform fruit set free from blemishes or sunken spots
Clean root crown without fungal damping-off or collar decay
Absence of curling, puckering, or mosaic leaf mottling
management: Prune lower diseased foliage with sanitized secateurs; dispose of off-field
Apply targeted bio-fungicides (Bacillus subtilis / Trichoderma) or copper-based sprays
Control sucking insect vectors promptly using yellow sticky traps and botanical sprays
prevention: Adopt raised nursery beds with nylon insect netting to prevent early vector transmission
Mulch beds with silver-black reflective plastic mulch to deter thrips and aphids
Water using drip irrigation at the base to keep foliage completely dry
Regularly rogue out and safely destroy virus-infected or blighted plants
